read_compressed_file_with_cat: read the contents of a compressed file using the cat method on GzipFileSystem
open_compressed_file_for_reading: open a compressed file in binary read mode using the _open method on BaseCompressedFileFileSystem
strip_protocol_from_path: strip the protocol prefix from a compressed file path using the _strip_protocol class method
get_directory_listing_for_compressed_fil: get the directory cache listing for a compressed file using the _get_dirs method
instantiate_compression_filesystem: instantiate a GzipFileSystem or Bz2FileSystem subclass to read compressed files as a virtual filesystem
